heading.description: Screen heading label for the settings page

scanUsageLabel.description: Settings row label for the scan usage figure

signOut.description: Settings row/button label that signs the user out

signOutConfirmTitle.description: Title of the sign-out confirmation prompt

signOutConfirmBody.description: Body of the sign-out confirmation prompt

signOutConfirm.description: Confirm button in the sign-out prompt

signOutCancel.description: Cancel button in the sign-out prompt

trash.description: Settings row label that opens the Trash screen

trashA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the Trash settings row

trashHint.description: Settings row subtitle for the Trash row

openOn.description: Settings row label for the screen the app opens on after sign-in and launch

openOnA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the Open on row; {{value}} is the current screen name

openOnHint.description: Screen-reader hint for the Open on row: what tapping it does

openOnPickerTitle.description: Title of the picker that chooses the screen the app opens on

openOnScan.description: Open on picker option and row value: the Scan tab

openOnWishlist.description: Open on picker option and row value: the Wishlist tab

openOnMyBooks.description: Open on picker option and row value: the My Books tab

openOnCancel.description: Closes the Open on picker without changing the choice

openOnSaveFailed.description: Error banner when the Open on choice could not be saved; the old value is restored

aiConsent.description: Settings row label: whether scan photos may go to the AI provider

aiConsentA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the AI scanning row; {{value}} is Allowed / Not allowed

aiConsentOn.description: Value of the AI scanning row when consent is given

aiConsentOff.description: Value of the AI scanning row when consent is not given

aiConsentOffHint.description: Hint under the AI scanning row when consent is not given

aiConsentWithdraw.description: Button that withdraws consent to AI scanning

aiConsentWithdrawHint.description: Screen-reader hint for the withdraw button

aiConsentWithdrawn.description: Banner after consent to AI scanning was withdrawn

exportData.description: Settings row label that asks for a copy of the user's data by email (#694)

exportDataHint.description: Subtitle and screen-reader hint of the Export my data row

exportConfirmTitle.description: Title of the export confirmation prompt

exportConfirmBody.description: Body of the export confirmation prompt: a link by email, valid 7 days

exportConfirm.description: Confirm button of the export prompt

exportCancel.description: Cancel button of the export prompt

exportQueued.description: Banner after the export was requested: the link comes by email, valid 7 days

exportLimited_one.description: Banner when an export was already requested today; {{count}} is the hours until the next one is allowed

exportLimited_other.description: Banner when an export was already requested today; {{count}} is the hours until the next one is allowed

exportUnavailable.description: Banner when the server cannot export yet (not set up)

exportFailed.description: Banner when the export request failed (offline or a server error)
